guide.overview: A versatile **dual-form Supporter**, Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow **keeps allies healed and reduces their spiritual damage taken**, then **awakens to deal AoE physical damage**. She also boosts the damage of [Justice League] and [Superman Family] allies.

legacyPieces.name: Absorption Collar
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Physical Penetration. After casting her Ultimate, Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow restores HP. Also boosts her Ultimate and skill damage, while helping [Justice League] allies take less spiritual damage and [Superman Family] allies take less physical damage.

legacyPieces.name: Gabriel Horn
legacyPieces.reason: Increases HP and grants a squadwide Attack bonus, boosting Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow's healing and transformed damage while increasing the squad's overall damage.

legacyPieces.name: Not-So-Huge Hammer
legacyPieces.reason: Provides HP, Attack, and Crit Damage bonuses, giving Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow useful boosts in both forms: stronger healing before she transforms and stronger physical damage afterward.

legacyPieces.name: Razor Rib Umbrella
legacyPieces.reason: Grants steady HP and Attack bonuses, improving Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow's survivability and healing. A reliable setup while you build toward stronger gear.
